calculation.expression: ((log_close.diff(20) - log_close.diff(60)/3) / (std(log_return,20)*sqrt(20))) * (1.0 if cross_asset_mean_20d_vol > rolling_median(cross_asset_mean_20d_vol,252) else 0.5), lagged 6 sessions
calculation.description: Ranks instruments by medium-term trend acceleration, scaled by instrument volatility. The signal is conditioned on the cross-asset realized-dispersion regime: high dispersion retains full trend strength and low dispersion halves it. The five-session information gap plus one completed-day lag prevents look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Robust across the full synthetic cross-asset history and recent windows; predictive strength rises from 1d to 10d and remains positive at 20d. Uncertainty is material because the cross-section is 15 instruments, despite many historical dates.
